compute_sigmoid_focal_loss: compute the sigmoid focal loss for RetinaNet dense detection with configurable alpha and gamma parameters
compute_sigmoid_focal_loss_star: compute the FL* variant of sigmoid focal loss from the RetinaNet paper appendix
use_jit_compiled_focal_loss: use the TorchScript compiled version of sigmoid focal loss for optimized inference performance
use_jit_compiled_focal_loss_star: use the TorchScript compiled version of FL* focal loss for optimized inference performance
apply_focal_loss_with_reduction: apply focal loss with mean or sum reduction to get a scalar loss value for training
